description:
Validate a standard 5-field cron expression (minute hour day month weekday). Returns a human-readable summary and any parse error.

Returns: JSON { valid: boolean, nextRuns?: string[], error?: string }.
Example input: {"expression":"*/5 * * * *"}
On error, includes hint: `expression` must be a 5-field cron (minute hour dom month dow). 6-field / Quartz syntax is not supported.
name: cron_validate
title: Cron expression validator
